cause: In services/reconciliation-drift/main.py (_scheduled_lifecycle_event), metadata was copied directly from the committed position_snapshot event. When reconciliation_completed was emitted for a fill journey (such as 2026-11-23T23:40:32Z 青禾 2330 sell, where all 9 booking checks passed), metadata.reason_code retained the inherited expression choice code ('close_leg'), which downstream BFF timeline mapping treated as an expression code in reason_code and replaced with 'reason_not_recorded'.
fix: services/reconciliation-drift/main.py (_scheduled_lifecycle_event): pop inherited reason_code from the copied position_snapshot metadata so reconciliation_completed never carries an inherited reason_code; if the inherited value is an expression choice code (long_cash, long_lever, short_via_future, close_leg), preserve it as metadata.expression_reason_code when not already set; reconciliation_failed continues to set its own reconciliation metadata.reason_code; no top-level reason fields and no new writer.

cases: test_recorded_20261123_completed_reconciliation_drops_inherited_expression_reason_code (recorded hosted 2026-11-23T23:40:32Z 2330 sell payload with metadata.reason_code='close_leg' and all 9 passed booking checks emits reconciliation_completed without reason_code, with metadata.expression_reason_code='close_leg', and with the passed booking checks in metadata.reason_detail)

test_recorded_20261125_failed_reconciliation_keeps_runtime_unhealthy_reason_code (recorded hosted 2026-11-25T12:11:10Z degraded-runtime payload emits reconciliation_failed with metadata.reason_code='runtime_unhealthy_at_reconciliation' and metadata.expression_reason_code='close_leg')
test_reconciliation_events_never_carry_expression_choice_as_reason_code (all 4 expression choice codes long_cash, long_lever, short_via_future, close_leg)

runtime_budget: No new writer, recurring job, or storage change; modifies only in-memory metadata fields on the existing reconciliation lifecycle event.
